name: r9-vectors-host-work-control
note: Control records (delegated host-work I.5.3 to I.5.5, II.3.1; host-work-v1 §11.1; planned: host.senders, not advertised). Wire {"body":{…},"sig"}; signing input enc(["atem-host-work-control-v1", jcs(body)]) (R9.1). The device list is r9-vectors-membership-log's log L followed by `chain` (labels of its others); signers' keys are r9-vectors-keys' (`signed_with`). A service record's principal_key is the r9_svc of the principal's auth_key (SHA-256 of its raw bytes, decision 8), written beside it. `checks`: verify_control's verdict on each chain (valid with the verified signer and, for the principal's own key, the seq that enrolled it; pending or refused with its reason); `parse_error`: the record's parse refuses it (in a feed, refused per record and kept as evidence; over a channel the whole control_records message is invalid_request). `sequences`: ControlState::apply on one host, step by step (the record, the list of the transaction, its feed position or none over a channel, host-work's applied device-list seq) with the record's result, each effect's result, the host's actions and whether the record is kept as evidence; `state` is ControlState::to_json after the last step. Record ids are UUID v4 numbered by record; issued_at orders covers (ruling T11a).

records.label: S1_cover
records.note: station-dev covers svc-discord (signed with the integration's service key)

records.label: S2_hold
records.note: a pause

records.label: S3_release
records.note: a resume

records.label: S4_revoke
records.note: the revocation; still valid after svc-discord's removal (E7): the principal's own key from the history signs every action

records.label: S5_revoke_interrupt
records.note: a revoke that adds interrupt_running: true

records.label: S6_interrupt
records.note: a later interrupt_running

records.label: S7_hold_after_revoke
records.note: a pause issued after the revoke

records.label: S8_revoke_unknown_by
records.note: about.by names a reason no host knows yet: display only, the record applies

records.label: B1_cover_stale
records.note: station-b's cover, issued a minute before S1_cover

records.label: B2_release
records.note: station-b's release, read before its cover

records.label: B3_cover
records.note: station-b's cover, newer than S1_cover: the integration moved

records.label: B4_hold
records.note: station-b's pause

records.label: B5_release
records.note: station-b's resume

records.label: A2_cover
records.note: station-dev's reset snapshot: its cover signed anew (newer) on the new feed

records.label: A2_hold
records.note: the snapshot's pause, signed anew after its cover

records.label: A2_release
records.note: a resume on the new feed

records.label: M1_revoke
records.note: a native manager's revoke of svc-discord (Astation)

records.label: M2_interrupt
records.note: a native manager's interrupt_running

records.label: M3_revoke_by_removed_manager
records.note: signed by dev-ipad while it was a manager, before E6 removed it; the host receives it after E6: refused and kept as evidence

records.label: M4_revoke_resigned
records.note: M3's stop signed again by dev-mac, a current manager: the same body, a new record_id

records.label: M5_revoke_by_pending_member
records.note: signed by dev-newmac: not in L, then the subject of a recovery_add still waiting (R7), then a manager once A8 approves it

records.label: M6_hold_by_manager
records.note: a native manager never signs cover, hold or release

records.label: H1_interrupt_7
records.note: interrupt host-a's tasks admitted before its revoke at seq 7 (HS7_revoke): pending until the list holds that revoke

records.label: H2_interrupt_7_again
records.note: another record for the same revoke_seq

records.label: H3_interrupt_12
records.note: for HS12_revoke_interrupt, a revoke that carried interrupt_running: true

records.label: H4_interrupt_not_a_revoke
records.note: revoke_seq 2 names E2 (host-a's add_host), not a revoke of host-a

records.label: H5_interrupt_unknown_host
records.note: host-b has no add_host in the list yet

records.label: H6_host_key_signed
records.note: signed by host-a's own host_key: a host's key signs no control record

records.label: V1_wrong_account
records.note: another account_id

records.label: V2_bad_signature
records.note: svc-discord's signature with its first byte flipped

records.label: V3_key_mismatch
records.note: principal_key names dev-mac's key, not svc-discord's (r9_svc beside it is svc-discord's)

records.label: V4_not_a_service
records.note: service:dev-phone names a native member

records.label: V5_principal_unknown
records.note: service:svc-new isn't in the list yet (its principal_key names a key the list doesn't hold)

records.label: V6_conflicting_id
records.note: S1_cover's record_id with another body: valid by itself; a host that counted S1_cover refuses it and keeps it as evidence

records.label: P1_host_release
records.note: a host principal's release (ruling T9a: refused at parse)

records.label: P2_service_revoke_seq
records.note: revoke_seq on a service's record

records.label: P3_host_feed
records.note: origin and feed_id on a host principal's record (bound to no feed)

records.label: P4_unknown_field
records.note: a field the body doesn't have

records.label: P5_by_not_a_label
records.note: about.by outside [a-z_]

records.label: P6_no_integration_id
records.note: a service's record without about.integration_id

records.label: P7_hold_interrupt_running
records.note: interrupt_running beside an action other than revoke

sequences.label: Q1_service_on_one_feed
sequences.note: cover, hold, release, then the revocation from the Station and from a native manager, its interrupt added later, and a pause after it

sequences.label: Q2_removed_manager_then_resigned
sequences.note: a stop signed by a manager removed before the host received it is refused (evidence); its re-signed copy applies

sequences.label: Q3_pending_signer
sequences.note: a record whose native signer the list doesn't hold yet waits, and applies once its recovery took effect

sequences.label: Q4_cover_from_another_station
sequences.note: ruling T11a: a stale cover from another Station neither takes coverage nor releases; a newer one takes coverage and the hold persists until the new feed releases

sequences.label: Q5_feed_reset
sequences.note: ruling T11a: a reset's newer cover (a duplicate) moves the ordering to the new feed; the old feed's release no longer applies

sequences.label: Q6_feed_reset_on_a_new_host
sequences.note: a host that never saw the old feed applies the snapshot: no stop is lost; the old feed's older cover is a duplicate that moves nothing back

sequences.label: Q7_host_interrupt
sequences.note: ruling T10a: pending until the list holds the revoke and host-work applied it (host_applied_seq); one interrupt per revoke_seq; a revoke entry with interrupt_running: true already interrupted

sequences.label: Q8_refused_and_kept_as_evidence
sequences.note: verification refusals and a reused record_id are evidence; a pending record is not

sequences.label: Q9_unknown_by_applies
sequences.note: an about.by no host knows applies: about decides nothing
